records.success_criterion: For pure four-parity data Q_rho(s)=(1+rho*s1*s2*s3*s4)/16 with 0<|rho|<=1, consider the normalized four-visible, one-hidden spin RBM P_(b,c,w)(s) proportional to exp(b dot s)*cosh(c+w dot s), and its expected log likelihood ell_rho. At every collapsed point (0,c0,0), with c0 any finite real, every affine parameter-direction derivative is zero. It is a local maximum in the full nine-dimensional parameter space if and only if tanh(c0)^2 < (3+2|rho|)/(3+6|rho|). At equality or beyond, every full parameter neighborhood has both a strictly higher and a strictly lower likelihood point. Every collapsed point has a strictly better finite RBM and distinct equal-likelihood points in every neighborhood; the local maxima are non-strict.
